articles.summary: When rime ice brings down a transmission line, it's already too late. Traditional weather models can't see it coming—they forecast regions, not assets. Our collaboration with Hydro-Québec validates that a weather foundation model like GFT can deliver day-ahead rime-ice alerts with 0.72 average precision, reducing expected dispatch costs while providing operators with actionable 72-hour warnings.
articles.title: Day-Ahead Rime-Ice: From Reactive to Preventive

articles.summary: Silurian and Hydro-Québec partner up to train Silurian’s Generative Forecasting Transformer (GFT) on utility-grade grid observation data to capture asset-level details and provide early warnings for catastrophic icing events. These results were recently presented at a CIGRE 2025 keynote.
articles.title: GFT for the Power Grid
